A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (23 December 2022). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Ref3-D-coloclawfish-PC-Errata-2022-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Colo Claw Fish (Dark) (PC Errata 2017-06 slip)]] (22 September 2017): The game text changes: “draw” becomes “draw.”. This is a full card image again, drawn anew at 745 × 1039 pixels, with the mark “D-E1” in the lower border.

The 2017-06 slip and the same area of the 2022 D-E1 card, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
